stem: Atorvastatin is in which class, and how does it lower circulating lipids?

options.label: A
options.text: Loop diuretic; increases urine sodium and lipid clearance only
options.misconception: Wrong class; diuretics are not statins.

options.label: B
options.text: Salicylate; blocks platelet aggregation pathways only
options.misconception: Aspirin class — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong class; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: C
options.text: Beta-lactam; blocks bacterial cell-wall synthesis only
options.misconception: Antibiotic class — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong class; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: D
options.text: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor statin; slows cholesterol production
options.explanation: MedlinePlus: statin that slows cholesterol production.

options.label: E
options.text: ACE inhibitor; blocks angiotensin II formation pathways only
options.misconception: Lisinopril class — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong class; see the cited source passage for detail.
